mappings.note: The pinned XSD requires this 1-120 character attribute on each SummaryLineItem. The identity is budget-row-specific because the form permits an Assistance Listing title, opportunity number, program code, or grant number.

The pinned XSD defines the optional per-row CFDANumber as a 1-15 character Assistance Listing number. This proposal gives it a conservative budget-row identity; the XSD does not establish equivalence with the opportunity-level value or prove which workflow actor supplies it.
The pinned XSD defines this optional direct-charge explanation as a string with length 1-50.
The pinned XSD defines this optional indirect-charge explanation as a string with length 1-50.
The pinned XSD defines these optional budget remarks as a string with length 1-250.
